pois.name: Gardens by the Bay
pois.description: Premier horticultural destination spanning 101 hectares, renowned for its iconic Supertree Grove, Cloud Forest mist conservatory with indoor waterfall, and Flower Dome.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-renowned biodomes featuring 35m indoor waterfall
✓ Iconic Supertree Grove & Garden Rhapsody light show
✓ Highly rated (4.8★) family-friendly highlight
pois.tip: Visit the cooled conservatories in the afternoon, then watch the Supertree light & sound show at 19:45 or 20:45. Fully accessible for all age groups.

provenance.place_verification: Verified Singapore Tourism Board National Landmark
provenance.price_source: Official Gardens by the Bay Two-Conservatories Ticket (28 SGD)

pois.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark & Waterfront Promenade
pois.description: 57th-floor cantilevered observation deck providing dramatic 360-degree vistas across Marina Bay, Singapore Straits, and the illuminated downtown skyline.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unmatched panoramic 360° views across Marina Bay and Singapore Strait
✓ World-famous architectural icon
✓ 4.7★ visitor satisfaction
pois.tip: Book timed entry around 17:30 to experience daylight skyline transition into twilight and nighttime city lights.

provenance.place_verification: Verified Marina Bay Sands Official Registry

pois.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens & National Orchid Garden
pois.description: 164-year-old tropical garden and Singapore's first UNESCO World Heritage site, housing over 1,000 pure species and 2,000 hybrids in the celebrated National Orchid Garden.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Singapore's premier UNESCO World Heritage Site
✓ World's largest orchid collection with over 60,000 plants
✓ Peaceful green sanctuary with shady walking trails
pois.tip: Enter via Tanglin Gate for heritage trees and lush rainforest boardwalks. Main botanical gardens are free; ticket covers the National Orchid Garden.

provenance.place_verification: UNESCO World Heritage Registry & NParks Singapore
provenance.price_source: National Orchid Garden Official Admission (15 SGD adult / free for children under 12)

pois.name: Sentosa Island & Siloso Beach
pois.description: Premier resort island destination featuring golden palm-fringed beaches, calm coastal lagoons, Fort Siloso historical skywalk, and scenic boardwalk trails.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Family-friendly seaside getaway with calm swimming lagoons
✓ Fort Siloso elevated Skywalk with coastal defense heritage
✓ Integrated free beach shuttle and monorail
pois.tip: Take the Sentosa Express from VivoCity (4 SGD inclusive of island entry) or walk the scenic Sentosa Boardwalk for free entry.

pois.name: Chinatown Heritage Centre & Buddha Tooth Relic Temple
pois.description: Magnificent Tang-dynasty style Buddhist temple complex housing sacred relics, surrounded by traditional shophouses, herbal tea merchants, and historic heritage alleys.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Striking Tang-dynasty architectural landmark in historic Chinatown
✓ Free cultural entry and serene rooftop orchid garden
✓ Rich living cultural quarter with artisan shophouses
pois.tip: Dress respectfully covering shoulders and knees. Don't miss the tranquil 4th-floor relic chamber and peaceful rooftop prayer wheel garden.

pois.name: Jewel Changi Airport
pois.description: World-acclaimed lifestyle hub featuring the 40-meter HSBC Rain Vortex—the world's tallest indoor waterfall—surrounded by the four-tier indoor Shiseido Forest Valley.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World's tallest indoor waterfall (40m) amid terraced forest trails
✓ Ideal arrival or departure highlight connected to all terminals
✓ 4.9★ global traveler rating
pois.tip: Rain Vortex viewing is completely free from all public vantage points. 8 SGD ticket covers the top-level Canopy Park walking net & glass bridge.

provenance.place_verification: Changi Airport Group Official Landmark Registry
provenance.price_source: Free Rain Vortex Access / Canopy Park 8 SGD

pois.name: Merlion Park & Fullerton Waterfront
pois.description: Singapore's iconic national emblem—the mythical half-lion, half-fish statue spouting water into Marina Bay with sweeping views of the downtown skyline.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic national symbol of Singapore
✓ Unobstructed views of Marina Bay Sands and ArtScience Museum
✓ 100% free public waterfront access
pois.tip: Visit in the early morning before 09:00 for soft golden light and gentle breezes without tour crowds.

pois.name: Singapore Flyer & Marina Bay Loop
pois.description: Asia's premier 165-meter giant observation wheel offering expansive 30-minute rotation flights with unobstructed views reaching Singapore Straits and nearby islands.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ 165m giant observation wheel with 360° air-conditioned capsules
✓ Panoramic perspectives across Formula 1 street circuit & harbor
✓ Fully accessible for children and elderly travelers
pois.tip: Time your flight 30 minutes before sunset (approx. 18:30) for spectacular golden hour and sunset views across the Marina.

provenance.price_source: Standard Flight Ticket (40 SGD adult / 25 SGD child)

pois.name: Lau Pa Sat Festival Market
pois.description: Historic 1894 Victorian cast-iron octagonal dining pavilion in the heart of downtown, offering authentic hawker stalls and Singapore's famous evening Satay Street.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Authentic Victorian heritage hawker pavilion
✓ Wide variety of vegetarian hawker stalls & fresh satay
✓ Vibrant evening atmosphere under heritage cast-iron arches
pois.tip: Stall 7 & 8 on Satay Street and internal vegetarian stalls serve vegetarian satay skewers with rich peanut sauce and fragrant ketupat rice cakes.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Vegetarian Satay with Peanut Gravy & Fragrant Hawker Fried Rice
pois.signature_dish: Mushroom & Soy Satay Skewers with Spiced Peanut Dip and Ketupat Rice Cakes
pois.dish_ingredients: Grilled king oyster and soy skewers, roasted peanut and lemongrass gravy, cucumber, pressed rice cakes (100% vegetarian)

provenance.place_verification: National Heritage Board & NEA Singapore Hawker Directory
provenance.opening_hours_source: Daily 24-Hour Pavilion Access / Satay Street from 19:00

pois.name: Little India & Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple
pois.description: Vibrant historic cultural enclave showcasing the 1881 South Indian temple with colorful gopuram tower, spice emporiums, traditional flower garland stalls, and authentic Indian eateries.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Authentic 19th-century Dravidian temple architecture
✓ Bustling cultural district with spice shops and flower stalls
✓ Premier center for authentic pure vegetarian dining in Singapore
pois.tip: Remove footwear before entering temple grounds. Morning prayer puja rituals around 08:30 offer captivating devotional chants and music.

provenance.place_verification: Singapore Hindu Endowments Board & Heritage Board

pois.name: Komala Vilas Pure Vegetarian Restaurant
pois.description: Singapore's oldest and most revered pure vegetarian South Indian dining institution, serving golden paper dosas, fluffy idlis, and traditional banana leaf thalis since 1947.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Legendary pure vegetarian institution operating since 1947
✓ Celebrated for Masala Dosai, Filter Coffee, and South Indian thalis
✓ Strict 100% vegetarian guarantee with zero meat or egg cross-contact
pois.tip: Order the Ghee Special Masala Dosa paired with traditional Madras filter coffee. Family-friendly with quick seating.
pois.vegetarian_dish: South Indian Banana Leaf Vegetarian Thali & Masala Dosa
pois.signature_dish: Ghee Paper Roast Masala Dosa with Trio of Fresh Chutneys and Piping Hot Sambar
pois.dish_ingredients: Fermented lentil-rice crepe, clarified butter (ghee), spiced potato mash, coconut & tomato chutneys, lentil vegetable sambar

provenance.place_verification: National Heritage Board Heritage Institution Registry

pois.name: Clarke Quay & Singapore River Walk
pois.description: Historic riverside commercial godowns restored into colorful pedestrian quays, featuring riverside walking bridges, scenic bumboats, and evening river breezes.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Restored colonial riverfront promenade
✓ Historic pedestrian bridges (Read Bridge, Coleman Bridge)
✓ Pleasant evening walking atmosphere along Singapore River
pois.tip: Stroll westward toward Robertson Quay for relaxed riverside promenades away from crowded music lounges.

provenance.place_verification: Singapore Tourism Board Historical Quarter Registry

pois.name: National Museum of Singapore & Fort Canning Park
pois.description: Singapore's oldest museum dating back to 1849, featuring immersive historical galleries in a magnificent 19th-century neo-classical dome building, adjoining Fort Canning hilltop park.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Singapore's oldest museum with world-class multimedia historical galleries
✓ Beautiful neo-classical architecture with interactive digital rotunda
✓ Connected directly to lush Fort Canning Park hillside trails
pois.tip: Explore the Singapore History Gallery on Level 1 first, followed by the enchanting 'Story of the Forest' interactive glass rotunda.

provenance.place_verification: National Heritage Board Singapore National Museum Registry

pois.name: Whole Earth Peranakan-Thai Vegetarian
pois.description: Singapore's acclaimed plant-based restaurant awarded the Michelin Bib Gourmand, specializing in authentic Peranakan and Thai culinary creations prepared entirely with natural plant ingredients.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Michelin Bib Gourmand awarded plant-based culinary highlight
✓ Authentic Nyonya & Thai curries made with fresh herbs and mushrooms
✓ Strict vegetarian verification with 4.7★ diner ratings
pois.tip: Reserve in advance. The signature Penang Rendang and Oatmeal Tofu with curry leaves are exceptional highlights.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Penang Rendang & Crispy Oatmeal Tofu with Peranakan Herbs
pois.signature_dish: Plant-Based Penang Rendang (Shiitake mushroom stems slow-braised in Peranakan spices and coconut milk)
pois.dish_ingredients: Shiitake mushroom stems, galangal, lemongrass, turmeric, roasted grated coconut (kerisik), kaffir lime leaves (100% vegetarian)

provenance.place_verification: Michelin Guide Singapore Bib Gourmand Registry

pois.name: Kampong Gelam & Sultan Mosque
pois.description: Historic Malay-Arab royal precinct centered around the iconic golden-domed Sultan Mosque, featuring pedestrian Haji Lane street murals, artisan perfumeries, and textile shophouses.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Magnificent golden dome Sultan Mosque landmark
✓ Vibrant Haji Lane street art murals and boutique craft shophouses
✓ Rich multicultural heritage with Turkish & Middle Eastern cafes
pois.tip: Explore the vibrant street murals on pedestrian Haji Lane in the morning, followed by the tranquil palm-lined Muscat Street promenade.

provenance.place_verification: Urban Redevelopment Authority & NHB Historic District Registry
